bsdu'i spyi darnga/la chen por bzhugs pa 'a/sa/ zhing 'di'i tshuzari rma/thong gdul bya thun mong ba'i ngor mchog gi spru la sku 'i rnam pas mdzad pa bcuganyis kyis skal bzang mi dang mi min gyitsho gdul/ byatsho dpag tu med pa 'phralasdigan phan bde'i lam la bkod par ra/ zad/ lhag par phrin las thams cad kyi rgyal 〈sna mgrin pa chonu/ kyi dung lanu/ byung ba'i gsung 'gag med tshangs nga 'i dbyangs/ kyis rigs can sasum gyi sa/sdus thun mong dang / thun mi/na gyigadul bya'i khams dbang mos blo sna tshoganu/ dang 'chams/ parochos 'khor rim/ pa gsum gyis mtshon pa'i theg dam/na dang thegachen /mdo dang sngags kyi theg pa'i chos tshul tshang la ma nor baji snyed cig brtsebs rjes su gdams pa rnar/sa dad ldan skasnye rī bzang lha klu mi nu+o/gas gdul bya mtha' ya/sa/ pa rnams kyisku/ gle so'i yu'/ du spyan drangs nas dar zhing rgyaju par ma/ zad/ khyarngapar du rgya gar 'phags nga 'iyāl du spes pa thun mo/nga dang / t+pālnga

min gyi bka' bsdu legs par byas te ston pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ 'dzam gling mngos nga/ra byed pa'i rkyan drug mchog gnyis/ rmad byung gi slo ba dpon bzhi/ mkhas pa sgo drug grub chen brgyad cu sogs theng rtogs gzungs spobs yon tan rgya madz+nyo lta bur mnga' dbang 'byor ba/ gcig las kyang gcig ngo ma tshar ba'i 'phags tshogs gser ri'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba lta bu sa chen po'i rdul dang mtshungs par byon nanu/ rgya gar snyesnaphagaskyusmu pa'i yul zhekuṭa ming dang don mtshungs pa'i gnas der/bstan 'dzin skyes chen nge dag gis rgyal bstan rin po che 'di nyid bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor los 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas mthar phyi pas nyams nyes su ma btang gi bar du dar zhing rkyas par gyur to/ des mtshon pa'i 'dzam gleng gi yu/la gru/bhar ma/ the la na/ seng ga ngu/ ri/ rgya nag sogs/ shar nub kyi rgyal khab ches mang po zhig tu yang nang bstan 'di nyid sngon rjes

ci rigs su dar zhing rgyas par gyur tshul rnams ni shes/ par 'dod na chos 'byung deb ther gzhan las shes par 'tshal 'o//lhag par brtsegadung 'o chu gcig tu 'dres shing / sha khrag rigs rus gcig las mched pa/ dpa' mdzangs snying sto/bas dang ldan pa/ lugs gnyis kyi blo mig ya/ngas shing / byams dang snying rje rgan bkur gzhon gces sogs ya/ rabs/ drang bden dam pa'i ngang tshul dri ma che/da pas rtag tu 'adz+nyo ba'i rang re bod mi na mas kyi mes po'i ya/nga mes sngon sprel rgan byang chub sems dpas bod mi'u gdung drug gi rigs/ rus bskyed nas da lta'i bar du mi rabs nas mi rabs bgrang las 'das pa rnams kyi lte ba'i mtshal thig gang du lhung ba'i gnas/ phyogs mtshams mu khyud kun nas rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba/ 'phags mchog mig mi 'dzum pa'i gdul zhing / chos srid dri ma med pa'i dpal yon zung 'brel/ 5

gyis rtag tu bde skyid kyis dus 'da' ba'i chos ldan sa la'i sman ljongs chen po bsil ldan gangs can ljongs 'dir yang / rang cag bod mi'i spyi mthun sngon bsags legs byas rnam dkar gyi 'bras bu dus su smin pa dang / sngon smon brlabs chen thugs bskyed med du byung ba mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul pa'i lo paṇa rim byon gyi phrin las zung du 'brel ba'i mthu las/ rgyal ba nyid kyis mdo rgyud du ma nas rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags don ltar 'phral yun kun tu phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pur nges pa kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid nyi ma byang bgrod dang chos mtshungs par mdo sngags kyi chos tshul tshang la ma nor ba 'dzam gling nor 'dzin gyi khyon 'dir rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan la med pa'i ngom rin chog pa'i ches rin thang dang bral ba'i chos dang rigs gzhung ji snyed cig gangs ljongs mun pa'i gling 'dir bsgyur zhus 'chad nyan 'dzin 6

skyong spel gsum gyis chos cher dar zhing rgyas pa de thams cad ston pa gcig gi bstan par gcig mtshungs yin par ma zad/chu klung thams cad mthar chu gter chen po'i klong du gzhol zhing 'bab pa dang chos mtshungs par mthar thug dgongs gnad bab so gcig kyang / dbang lung gdams pa rnams gang nas gang la ji ltar brgyud tshul gyi khyad par/ gnas skabs grub mtha'i bzhed pa phyag bzhes phrin sgrub cung zad kyi khyad par las/rdo rje 'chang gi lam tshang la ma nor ba ston pa 'i sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta chen po brgyad kyi lam srol chen po brgyad yan lag dang bcas pa mchis pa las de yang sgrub brgyud 'adz+ren pa'i shing rta chen po brgyad ni/ mkhas grub chen po 'phreng po gter chen shes rab 'od zer gyi zhal nas/ ji skad du/ zhu chen lo tsā pa gor bai ro dang / rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshome 'brom ston khu/ pa si/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor pa/ skad gnyis smra ba bla chen 7

'brog mi dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun mar pa'i zhabs/ grub pa'i sar bzhugs dam pa rgya gar dang / gyi gyi da/ nā+o mkhas grub yigo rgyan pa/ byang phyogs sgrub brgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen brgyad/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nas legs 'ong ba'i/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgrub brgyud srol chen brgyad/ de dag grub chen gong ma'i gshegs shul te/ thar 'dod rnams kyang lam/ de'i rjes su zhusas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / de dag gi lam srol chen po brgyad kyang / rgyal bas lu/nga bstan mjod lnga'i shing rta chen pa bla gras mtha' yas kyi zhal snga nas/ji skad du/ bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyu/da dang / shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ zhes gsungs pa ltar snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / bka' gdams gsar rnying / lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ mar pa'i bka' brgyud shangs pa bka' brgyud/8/

dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed/ sbyor drug yan lag dang bcas/ pa/ rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor te brgyad po rnams las/ de dag sa sa' brgyud rim/ lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi bzhed mtshams/ thun min gyi smin grol gdams pa dmar khrid ra/na ngag rnams ji ltar nyams bzhes su mdzad tshul dag ni gsar dz+nyang mkhas grub dam pa dag gis ma/dzad pa'i lesanu/ sagad rnams las kha gsal zhib rgyas su/ 'khod yod pas rtogs par 'dod na de dag la gzigs par 'tshal/ lo/de las da res 'dir skabs su bab pa'i gtam dus su bab pa'i char dang mtshungs par ma/khas grub chen po khyung rngo/ rnal 'byor las brgyud pa'i dpal lda/na shangs pa bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags pa'i bka' srol 'di nyid ji ltar byung 9

tshul dang / dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos 'di nyid gtso bor nyams bzhes su gnang ba'i gdan sa khag kha cig ngos bzung ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos ljongs 'dir 'adz+ren pa'i shing rta chen pa grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor mchog gi thun mong phyi yi mdzad rnam mdor bsdus dang / dam pa de las byung ba'i shangs pa'i bka' srol 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa'i rim pa ngos bzung ba gnyis las/dang po ni/ rgyal bas nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen por lung bstan pa mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor brtson 'grus mgon zhes bya ba 'di nyid rus rigs khyung po yin pa yab khyung rgyal stag skyes zhes bya ba dang / yum mgon bza' bkra shis skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung dang po'i/ spyi lo 978sa stag lor snye mo ra mang du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams ma thag grub thob a mo gha badz+ra byon nas lung ske0

bstan gnang don 'di lta ste/ 'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste rgya gar bgrod/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub thob thams cad kyi/ thugs bcud bsdus nas 'gro rnams smin grol byed/ sna tshoges sprul pas gdul bya 'dul bar 'gyur/ 'di yi lus ni bde mchog 'khor lo ste/ gsung ni ma hā ma ya'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ thugs ni dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje ste/ sprul/ pa'i gnas mchog gsang ba 'dus pa la/ gsang ba bde skyong gshin rje gshed du 'gyur/dkyil 'khor de rnams lus la bkod nas kyang / sadul bya rnams la dngos su ston par byed/ gzhan yang yi/ dam sna tshoges gzugs bsgyur nas/ gdul dka'i skye bo dpag med 'dul bar byed/ lo 3 brgya dang lnga bcu 'cho bar 'gyur/ de yi mthar ni mdzad pa btul ba'i tshe/ ltas dang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston par 'gyur/ de nas zhing khams rnam dag bde ba can/ rgyal ba kun bsngags zhing der sangs rgyas nas/ theg nage

chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ phyi rabs dad ldan brgyud 'dzin thams cad kun/ rgyal ba'i zhing der 'gro bar the tshome med/ zhes gsungs nas mkha' la bya bzhin rgya gar du sku gshegs par gsungs shing / sku na gzhon nu'i dus su 'bri klog sogs mkhas par gyur/ pha mes bon po yin pas thog mar bon gyi sgor zhugs te g.yung drung rgyal/ las bon phyi nang kun la bslabs nas mkhas par gyur/ bar du rdzogs chen 'byung gnas seng ge so/gas las rdzogs chen dang phyag chen gsan pas mkhas shing grub pa thob kyang / sngon gyi las 'phro dang byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dus su son pas de dag gis thusas yid ma mim pa'i tshul mdzad nas sngon gyi lung bstan bzhin rgya gar du phebs rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de gser mang po bsnams te phyin pas bal por lo gsum gyi ring paṇ+ḍi ta su ma te las lo tsā bslabs/ kri'iya'i chos gsan nas mthar na2

a thu la badz+ra gyis grogs byas te rgya gar rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas gnyis par lung bstan pa bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal te rab tu byung nas 'dul ba lung dang mdo rtsa ba sogs dang /gzhan yang shri bha dra dang / iṇ+ḍa bhu tichung ba sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas chos dang rig gnas mang du sbyangs te bod du phebs/glang ri thang pa rdo rje sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ slar yang gces pa'i srog la ma ltos par rgya gar du phebs pa sogs snga phyi bar gsum lan grangs bdun tsam rgya gar dang bal po bcas la phebs nas khyad 'phags kyi bla ma bcu gsum sogs mkhas grub bla ma dam pa brgya dang lnga bcu gser dang mos gus sogs kyis tshul bzhin mnyes par byas te/ dbang byin brlab dang bcas pa/ rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa zhus/ khyad par du rtsaba'i bla ma khyad 'phags rdo rje gdan pa/ me tri pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ ra hu la ste bzhi dang / 'gran zla med pa'i thun min 43

gyi bla ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma/ su kha sirnyi gnyis bcas drug gabo ra bsten cing / ni gu chos drug gser chos rnams lngas mtshon pa'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs mang po'i lag len gdams ngag chig brgyud bka' rgya dang bcas pa zhus te gtum mo mthar thug dgyes mdzad/ las rgya mthar thug bde mchogasgyu lus 'od gsal mthar thug gsang 'dus/ rmi lam mthar thug ma hā ma ya/ phrin las mthar thug 'jigs mdzad de rgyud sde lnga sku yi gnas lngar dngos su grub pas mtshon grub chen mda' bsnun zhabs sogs ye shes sgyu ma'i sku brnyes pa rnams dang mi gnyis pa grub pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i dam pa des lo gsum gyi ring dgon gnas brgya rtsabatab pa'i ya gyal gtsang g.yas ru shangs kyi zhang zhong du gdan sa mdzad pas bla ma la shangs pa/ brgyud 'jin rnams la shangs pa bka' brgyud du grags shing / des bshad sgrub chos kyi bya ba rgya cher mdzad tshul na4 —

mdor bsdu na/ bshad pa dang / rtsod pa sgrub pa'i lam rim gsum du 'du ba ste/ bshad pa'i lam rim/ mdo dang de yi bstan bcos/ rgyud dang rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa/ mtshan nyid theg pa la grub mtha' chen po bzhi/ rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde chen po ba'itshul bzhin du bshad pa dang rtsod pa'i lam rim la tshad ma sde bdun/ rtog ge phyi rabs pa'i lugs gsan kyang / gabo tshad ma snga rabs pa la grags pa ltar gtan tshigs chen po bzhis mtshan nyid gsum gtan la dbab cing / tshad ma yang mngon sum/ rjes dpag yid ches rjes dpag gsum du phye nas brgal lan rnam par nges par byed pa dang / sgrub pa'i lam rim la rgyu phar phyin theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa gnyis kyi nyams len mtha' dag kyang byang phyogs so bdun dang / khyad par gyi gnad kyi nyams su len tshul man ngag ngu dril nas bstan cing / sa chen po'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams na5

smin cing grol bar mdzad cing / slob tshogs kyang snga bu lnga/ phyi bu gcig bcas drug gis mtshon pa'i bshes gnyen khri phragabaco barbod kyis bshad sgrub kyis bstan pa spel zhing / dgung grangs brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs nas mthar gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su re zhig bsdu bar mdzad do/gnyis pa/ dam pa de las byung ba'i dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' srol 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa'i rim pa ngos bzung ba la//spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du gdams pa'i khyad chos bshad pa dang /gang gis gang la gdams pa'i brgyud pa'i rim pa dngos bshad pa dang / gang zhig brgyud pa'i chos kyi mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ gangs ljongs mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan rgyal bas lung bstan ris med bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'jam mgon blo ༷yog mtha' yas kyi zhal nas/ ji skad du/ srid mtha'i byang sems 'ba' zhig phreng bar brgyud/16

ma nor ma bslad ṭ+wāṃ ki rdo rje'i tshab/ dus kyi mthar yang grub pa'i 'bras bu smin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gdams pa'i bka' srol 'di ni gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa ste/ de yang dang po brgyud 'dzin khyad par du 'phags pa srid pa tha ma ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig phreng bar brgyud pa las/ gang zag tha mal bas bar du ma chod pa dang / gnyis pa gdams ngag khyad par du 'phasas pa don ma/ nor zhing mig ma bslad pa ye shes shā kis thems su btab pa'i rdo rje'i mig rkang so skyes blos brtag kyis bcos bsgyur rtsom pa ma phog pa/ gsum pa/ byin brlabs khyad par du 'phags pa snyigs ma'i dus kyi mthar thug 'dir yang brtson 'grus ldan cing dam tshig ma nyams pa la grub pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum mthong bas bshad tshode tsam du ma lus pa dang bcas te rnam pa gsum mo/ des na chos tshul 'di tshul bzhin du nyams bzhes na7

su gnang na bde bas thabs byas pa'i stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mthar thug pa bskal pa dang tshe rabs lta bu dus kyi ma bskal bar tshe 'di'am bar do gang rung du mngon du 'gyur nges su gsungs pas mos ldan skal bzang dag spro bas rjes su 'dug rigs te/ rtsab rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ ji skad du/lam gyi mchog gyur 'di nyid nyams len na/ gzhan gyi dus min 'di'am bar ma do/ bde stong dbyer med sku gsum ngang shar nas/ rnam par dag pa'i mkha' spyod nyid du 'gro/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ gnyis pa gang gi gang la gdams pa'i brgyud pa'i rim pa dngos bshad pa de la gsum ste/ ring brgyud/ nye brgyud/shin tu nye brgyud do/dang po ni/ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang/ des ye shes kyi ṭ+wāṃ ki ma ni gu ma'am ni dhi gnyis/ des grub chen khyung rka8

po rnal 'byor/ des rang slob khri phrag bco brgyad kyis bshad sgrub bstan pa spel zhing / khyad par sras kyi thu bo rnam pa drug gis brgyud pa'i rkang bzung ba las/ mchog tu gyur pa rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus la chig brgyud kyi bka' babs te de nas rim pa ltar skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/ gnyan ri pa/gangs pa chos kyi shes rab/ 'gro mason sangs rgyas ston pa'i bar du snyan nas chig brgyud du rim par brgyud pa la rin chen rnam bdun snga mar grags/ des rdo rje 'chang dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgya bkral te gdams pas slob brgyud grub thob 'dzam gling dang gling phran tshun khyab par mdzad pa las/ khyad par rang slob ma khas grub rnam pa gsum gyis snyan brgyud yi ger bkod/ mkhas grub shangs sto/na nas rgya sgom legs rgyal bar du brgyud pa la 'di la rin chen rnam bdun phyi ma'i mtshan du chags shing don la'ang grub pa'i go na9

'phang snga ma rnams dang mnyam nges par gsungs shing / smad brgyud du grags pa 'di khyung po lan gsum/ rmog lcog lan gnyis bzlas pa tshang bas thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa yin par bzhed/ nang gses sa sa slob ma yang slob rnams las ji ltar brgyud tshul mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa chos 'byung rgyas pa gzhan las zhib rgyas su shes par 'tshal shing 'dir ma spros so/gnyis pa nye brgyung ni/ kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas kyi sku skye phyi ma grub chen brtson 'grus bzang po'am/ thang stong rgyal po soges sku gcig la mtshan lnga dang ldan pa de nyid kyis ring brgyud mkhas grub shangs ston gyi slob ma mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang nas ri gong stod brgyud du grags pa'i snyan brgyud rnams byang sems sbyin pa bzang po las gsan nas thusas nyams su bzhes pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dngos kyi 20

rjesasu stsong ba'i nye brgyud bka' bab kyi rim pa gsum byung ste/dang po ni gtsang gi ri bo cher ni gu ma dngos su byon nas/ chonu/ drug phyag chen/ lam khyer/ 'chi med/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med rnams kyi khrid/ gnyis pa ni/ mdo smad srin rdzong shugs sdong gi rtsabar de dag sa sa' dbang / gsum pa ni/mkha' spyod kyi gdams pa yi/ ge med pa'i brda thabs su byung ba bcas mang mkhar ba blo ༷le rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan sogs las so trere brgyud de da lta'i bar du bka' brgyud zam ma chad par bzhugs so/gsum pa shin tu nye brgyud ni/ nag po spyod pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog zhabs kyis ring brgyud 'jag bsam gnyis las byung ba'i brgyud pa'i rnam grangs nyer bzhi dang / khrid thengs lan grangs brgya lhag gnu/na cing phyis su dag pa'i snang bar zung wīg sku can rdo rje btsun mo/ 2

gis gup+tas snyan brgyud gdams ngag snga ma las kyang khyad par du gyur pas/ zur brgyan te stsal bas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ khrid tshul 'de kho na lan grangs brgya lhag mdzad cing skal ldan du ma smin grol gyi rgyal sar bkod pa las thugs sras kyi ga ba chas sku lha dbang grags pa nas rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra na tha la brgyud de yig chung zur du ma 'khod kyang gdams ngag gi ngo 21 bzhugs bzhin pa nyid do/ gzhan yang byang sems chu sgom pa la ni gu mas dngos su stsal ba sogs gdams ngag yi ger ma 'khod pa'i rigs dang /'khod kyang yongs su ma grags pa'i rigs thor bu mang du bzhugs par gsungs pa ltar ro/gsum pa gang zhig brgyud pa'i chos kyi mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba ni/ ni gu'i chos skor/ su kha'i chos skor/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos skor/ me tri ba'i chos skor/ ra hu la'i chos 22

skor te lnga dang / der ma 'thus pa'i ma/na ngag thor bu dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis/ na'ang/ deng sang chos rje mus pa dang / bka' brgyud sogs su rne ni gu'i chos skor gabo ra gyur pa la/ ji skad du/ rtsab chos drug sdong po ga'u ma/ yal ga lam khyer me tog mkha' spyod gnyis/ 'bras bu lus sems 'chi med gyur pa ste/ bka' brgyud shangs pa'i nyams len gabo yin/ zhes pa ltar rtsab ni gu chos drus/sdong po phyag rgya chen po ga'u la// yal/ sa lam khyer rnam gsum/me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'u/sa sems 'chi med/ bka' srung ye shes mgon po'i skor rnams kyi smin grol/ rgyab brten dang bcas pa las/dang po smin byed dbang la/ chos drug gi smin byed khog dbub gsum/ sgos bka' drug phyag chen bka' lnga/mkha' spyod bka' gsum/ gsang sgrub bka' lnga/ mgon po 23

bka' gnyis dang drug las/dang po ni chos drug spyi yi khog phub/ rgyud sde lnga gco bor gyur pa'i 'jug sbo sgyu lus dbang mo che dang gcig bde mchog dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs dang gnyis/ lha bzhi dril sgrub bcas gsum mo/ gnyis pa ni/ gtum mo/ sgyu lus sogs chos drus sa sa' dbang bcas drug gogasum pa ni/ phyag chen ga'u ma/ bla ma/ yi dam/ ñdzi lus lam khyer/ lus sems 'chi med kyi dbang dang lnga'o/ bzhi pa ni/ mkha' spyod dkar mo dmar mo sum phrug gi dbang dngagasum mo/ lnga pa ni/ bde mchog spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin bcas lnga'o/drug pa ni/ phyag drug pa dang / mgon dkar gnyis/ zhar byung su kha sidhi byin brlabs bcas so/ gnyis pa grol byed khrid la/ thang chol/ mus pa/ ta ra nā tha sogs kyi yi cha'i steng nas chos drug phyag chen/ la/ma khyer rnamagasum/chi mkha' spyod dkar 24

dmar gyi 'pho ba/ lus sems 'chi med/ bla mgon dbyer med rnams kyi nyams khrid bcas so/ gsum pa lung la/ rtsab rdo rje'i chig rkang sogs blags bam gcig lhag na mas/ baṭakyigs so/gnyis pa shangs pa'i gser chos 'di nyid gtso bor nyams bzhes su gnang ba'i gdan nu/ khas kha cig ngos bzung ba la gnyis/ spyir shangs chos kyi gdan nu/ kha cig ngos bzung ba dang / khyad par du rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen mo'i rten dang brten pa'i byung ba rags tsam bshad pa gnyis las/dang pe ni/ gtsang shangs yul du grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor mchog gi gdan sa gtsang zhang zhong rdo rje gdan ni shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi 'byung gnas lta bu yin/ sde dge rdzong khongs su dpal spung yang khrod rtsa'adra ri khrod kong sprul rin po 25

che'i gdan sa/ chab mdo ri bo che'i rdzong du 'jam mgon blo grose mtha' yas kyi yang srid gnyis pa 'odze sgar kong sprul du grags nga/ blo gros rab 'be+el ra/chog ge gdan sa ma'epyo kha dgon pa sogs dang / gzhan yang bka' brgyud pa'i dgon sde che phra phal/ mo che rnams kyang dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos 'di nyid nyams bzhes su bstar ba'i dgon gnas su ma gyur pa med pa lta bus mtshon deng sang 'phags bod sogs phyi nang gi rgyal khab ches mang po zhig tu chos brgyud 'di 'dzin pa'i dgon sde dang chos brgyud 'di nyid kyis khyab pa lta bur mngon pa 'di ni rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyis thugs bskyed dang phrin las kho nar lags so/gnyis pa rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen mo'i rten dang brten pa'i byung ba rag tsam brjod pa la gsum te/dad ldan skal bzang rnams spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du sbas gnas 26

chen mo'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa rdo rje'i gnas yig gis ngo sprod zhu ba dang / rten chos sde 'di gang du chags pa'i gnas phun sum chogs pa'i bkod pa bshad / brten pa dgon sde'i byung tshul rags bsdus bshad pa gsum las/dang sku ni/ de yang sprul pa'i gter chen a rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i zab gter khams kyi gnas chen nyer lnga'i mdo byang las/ gnas 'di yon tan gyi gnas lnga las yon tan gyi yon tan gyi gnas su lung gis bsngags par gsungs shing /bka' bab bdun ldan rdo rje gzi brjid dam 'jam dbyangs/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i gter byon gnas yig rdo rje'i zhal lung las 'di ltar gsungs te/ rtsagasumayangs rdzogs lha la/ 'dud: kun bzang pad+ma sam ghaba'i : dbyings dang ye shes zung 'jug pa: rig rtsal thig le'i cho 'phrul las: rlogs brgyad rnam par dag pa yi: bde gshegs yongs dzogs sgrub 27

sde brgyad: 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor shar: lha dang sngags dang ting 'dzin ni: bsam ya/sa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar:'og min nges pa lnga ldan zhing : bod kyi yul du 'phos pa ni:sbas yul shangs kyi zab bu lung : sgo gsum lung bdun zab dbe+en dgu: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang che: mthong thos dran pa'i don ldan zhing : mchog gi dngos grub stsol med 'grub: thun mong dngos grub ro/gas las 'byung : kla klo gdus pa'i rtsub 'gyur dpung : zil gnon khrag 'thung rol pa'i grong : ngo mtshar 'gran zla bral bar bzhugs: de las ye shes rigs bzhi'i 'phrul: 'gag med chu zla'i gzugs brnyan ltar: gangs can phyogs bzhir snang ba las: shar phyogs 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i zhing : yon tan bsngags pa 4mtha' yas pa'i: sbas gnas kun gyi ga ba : bde bar gshegs pa 'dus pa'i rdzong : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i 28

shod: nyi shu rtsabazhi'i bkod pa can: lha btsan klu yi srung ma gis: sbas te srung ba'i zhing khams yod: de la 'jug pa'i sgo gsum ste: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i tshul: phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i brag sgyibs dang : rang byung chu mig ljon pa'i shing ca dza lan+dha ra la sogs pa: bkod pa brgyad tshan gsum gyirdabus: 'dab brgyad pad+ma'i ri yi sul: grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad dang : bde gshesas brgyad kyi chogs/ khang dbus: kun 'dus dpal gyi pho brang ni: dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyi: rtsagasum dal 'bab chu bo'i tshul/:rdo rje'i sku dang 'gag med gsung : bde chen thusas dang yon tan rgyan: phrin las thogs pa meng pa/'i rtsal: 'khor lo lnga ldan phug pa'i dbyibs: de na rang byung he ru ka'i: rnam par 'phrul pa dpag yas pa'i: phyag rgya sngags dang ye shes kyitshomatshan ma rang byung tshul du bzhugs: khyad par tsit+ta sasang ba'i 29

sbubs: ya mtshan shel gyi gzhal med khang : rdo rje tshe yi chu rgyun dang : dngos grub rdzas kyi mtshan pa na: ye shes chen po'i gter gyi bcud: bsam yas brngod pa kun gyi gzhi: kun 'dus kun las khyad par 'phags: kun gyi snying dril chen po bzhugs: de lta bu yi byin rlabs kyis: sa gzhi lhun chags sangs/ rgyas dang : yi dam byang sems zhi dang khri'i: bkod pa du ma bsam mi khyab: rdo rje'i brag la rig pa 'dzin9 bla ma'i phyag zhabs rjes mang dang : yi dam zhi khro'i lha dang sngags: ṭ+wāṃ ki'i thugs kyi mtshan ma snang : rang byung chu mig dkar dmar ni: myong grol thabs shes rdzas kyi tshul: me shel nyi ma/'i 'char tshul dang : 'byung ba'i rlung khams 'khyil ba yis: tshe ngang nor gyi g.yang zhag 'khyil: dngos grub chu —mig du ma dang : ya/ mtshan dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing :rin chen 'bar ba'i sa 'dzin dang : nor bu'i rdo leb bkram pa 30

yis: tshe dang 'byor pa yid du 'ong : nyams chag skong dang mthu dbang stsol: gshin rje dus kyi me lce'i grong : gnam — lcags 'bar ba'i phug pa na: drag sngags mthu dang lngan pa yisaca gdug pa ma lus tshar lag gcod: srung ma lha chen phyag bzhi pa: rdo ba'iphug la brten te gnas: dbang gi ma mo māṃ ka: rak+ta'i rdzing bur lus phyed thon: ci bgyi'i bka' nyan ging ka ra: byang phyogs dur khrod chen por 'du: ngo mtshar khyad 'phags grong khyer der: dpa' bo ṭ+wāṃ ki'i chogs rnams kun: mar ngo'i tshes bcur lhag par 'du: bya gcan sha zan godugo pa'i tshul:ོ cho 'phrul rnam pa cir yango ston:ོder ni drad thab rnal 'byar pas: brtul zhugs spyad pa skyang ba na:mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya che'i: ye shes rtsol med rang las shar: snying po thugs kyi pho brang du: zab don lha'i pa'i sdetshugs na: bodayāl bstan 'gro thams cad dang :4shegs 3

pa'i bstan pa yun du gnas: dad pa can gyi skye bo rnams:gnas 'di mthong ba tsam gyis kyang : snang bar 'gyur zhing 'dod blo zhig: phyag dang bskor ba sus byas pa: lus kyi sdig pa thams cad 'dag: gsol 'debs bzlas brjod brtson pa yis: ngag gi sgrib pa rang sar zhi: mos gus chen pos gsol btab na: byin rlabs zhugs shing nyams rtogs 'char: tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba yis : thun mong dngos grub rtsol med 'byung : 'khor lo'i 'dubar sus spyod pa: rten der zung 'jug go 'phang 'grub : srung dang zhi rgyas dbang drag las: gang brtsam thogs pa med par 'char: gzhan yang rdo rje'i lam zhugs pas: thar pa chen po'i rten 'brel 'grigs: bdud rtsi'i rgyun la khrus byas pas: sgrib pa dag cing tshogs chen rdzogs: byang chub shing drung mnyam bzhag na:spyan dang mngon shes rtsol med 'byung : shar phyogs rdo rje'i phug 32

pa ru: bsgom na bskyed rim drod rtasas myur: lho phyogs bdud rtsi'i khrus khang du: rtsarlung gtum mo'i bde drod 'char:nub phyogs dbang gi brag skyibs suju thabs lam zab mo'i brtul zhugs rdzogs: byang phyogs shel gyi gsang phug tu:mnyam par bzhag pa'i ka dag rdzogs: seng ges btegs pas bgyengs ba'i thod: rdo rje sems dpa'i me long yod:der ni mngon sum rig pa'i gnad: gzir na sna/nga ba'i'i rtsa la chen rdzogs: dbus kyi shā bi'i bro ra ru: rdo rje'i gar dang rdo rje'i glu: rdo rje'i lta bas rab bltas na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i yid bskul zhing : nye rgyu'i spyod pas grang mdzad de: phyi nang kun tu dge legs 'byung : mdor na mthong thos dran res dang : bzang ngan las kyi 'brel ba kun: rnam pa kun tu don lngan pa'i: rdo rje gsang ba mchog si grong : de dang de yi yan lag kyang : yang dag grub pa'i pho brang dang : gasnad sbyin 33

gter 'chang rol pa'i zhing : pad+ma tshe yi gsang phug dang : rdo rje khro bo 'chol pa'i grong : phyogs kyi 'dab 'byor rnams su yod: kun kyang ngo mtshar ram 'byams phyir: ma 'ong sprul pa'i skyes buyis: sten 'brel zab mo'i sgo phyes na: lha yis me tog char 'be+ebs shing : klu yis snod bcud 'byor pa spel: mi rnams bde ba'i dpal la stso+od: gang 'brel thun mong dngos grub dang : ma/chog gi ye shes lhun gyis grub:bkra shis/ dge legasayā/na du gnas: kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid stsal gyi thugs las brdol ba'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang /pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal dang rig 'dzin las rab gling pa zung gis mdzad pa'i gnas yig bsdus don rab gsal snying po las/ rigs/ kun khyab bdag mcho lces rje'i/rnam rol/ dpal chen sgrub sde brgyad/ ḍā ki'i chos srung la btud de/ ngo mtshar gnas kyi lo rgyus dbye/ rdzong shod bde 34

gshegs 'dus pa'i gnas kyi dbu rtser 'jam dpal sku yi wawa rgonas/ de'i dbu rtser gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis hūṃ 'jam dpal gzhin rje'i sgrub phug g.yas su dran pa gsang / spya phurge brag dkar rtsemathon 'og tu gu ru rin po che'i sgrub phugardo derke 'og shud bu dpal seng sgrub phug de 'og ri spang mtshams su 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug rgyal ba byang chub/ lha lu/nga dpal gyi rdo rje rnams kyi sgrub phug bcas/ gsung gnas mdun ngos su rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis dbang chen rta mgrin sgru/ba phug g.yas phyogs su paṇa chen bī mas sgrol dkar sgrub phus/ de 'og tu masna ngargyal gsang phug bcas/ thugs gnas dbus n+ḍi susang dag tshogs khang chen mo zla gam sgo gcig pa'i gzugs/phug pa'i klad du lha lcar/ ra/n+dha ra banu/ byin gyis/ brlabs/ nga/'i phug pa/ g.yas ngos su ye shes dbyings kyi sgrub phug g.yon ngos su gnubs/ chen nam mkha'i snying po'i sgrub phug yonganu/ 35

grags tsit+ta gsang phug dang bī ro'i sgrub phug bcas/ yon tan gnas rdzong chen gyi mdun ngos su gnyags chen dz+nya nas bdud rdziyon tan sgrub pug shar ngos su bī mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i phug pa/ rtse logs su sog po lha dpal gyi sgrub phug nub ngos su brag rtsar rma thog rin chen gyi sgrub phug byang ngos su g.yu sgra snying po dang / khye'u chung lo tsā'i sgrub phug bcas/ phrin las gnas kyi lho ngos su sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub phug de'i ltag ngos su lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi gsang phug bcas/ dbus kyi dpal de'u rtselnga pa can gyi mdun ngos su chos rgyal khri srong gis bka' brgyad sgrub phugagayon ngos su lha sras mu rub kyi sgrub phug bzhugs/ sku gnas g.yon ngos kyi brag rtse'i ngos rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku rang byon 'ja' gor gyi nang du bzhugs pa/ gsung gnas sbas phug gi steng byang bstan ngos su rta phag rang byon/ lho 36

phyogs brag gdong ngos seng gdong ngamar mo phur sham can gyi sku/ sgrol dkar sgrub phug gi 'gram du 'i sdong po dang tai ram̐sgarang byon/ mdun ngos lam ltag brag ngos su gu ru yab tshoyusmra kyi zhabs rjes/ 'bru gsum rang byon bcas/ thugs dzorgunasalang dag tshogs khang chen mo'i steng ngos g.yon phyogs la rdo rje sems dpa'i sku brnyan rang byon/ tshogs khang nang log g.yon ngos su ral gri rang byon/ rgyab ngos byang phyogs su tshe bum rang byon/ 'og ngos phug logs/ su nam snying phyag zhabs/ gi rjes/ tsit+ta gsang phug gi snyeng du phyag rdor rang byon bcas/:nge chen brag gi nub ngos g.yas phyogs su che mchog rang byon dbu nyi shu rtsagacig shin tu gsal ba/ de'i g.yon gyi brag ngos su bka' brgyad pho brang gling dgu/ mdun 'og tu bdud rdzikhro mkhar bcas/ phrin las gnas kyi 'og tu lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka/rak+ta'i rdzing nas sku phyed thon pa'i tshul/ sanas lnga gtso bor gyur 37

pa'i phyogs mtshams rnam/sa su bka' rtags yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan phyag zhabs kyi rjes gsal dang mi gsal gnas yig rgyas pa rnams su 'khod pa ltar mang du bzhugs/ gsung gnas lam chen 'gram du karma pa dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhabs rjes sogs thor bu mang / lca/ma mo'i mdun ngos sku gnas g.yas phyogs brag dkar ngos su byang chub mchod rten shin tu gsal ba gnas chen lnga yi mdun ngos su mkha' 'gro'i bro ra la tshogs kyi 'khor la bsko/ra na phan yon khyad par can thob pa bcas bzhugs/ mtha' bskor rgyas pa la yig drug dung phyur brgya/mtha' bskor bsdus pa la dung phyur lnga bcu/ nang gi lnga bskor la dung phyur nyer lnga/ nang bskor la dung phyur bdun gyi 'gyurawaṃ shes mkha' 'gro mcho rgyal gyi rdo rje'i lung don ltar dus rgyun du yod pa yin zhing / khyad par yo/sa lo nam shar du dur khrod brgyad dang / gnas chen nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 38

5ñdzi 'du ba khyad par can yod pas phyag bskor/ mchod 'buwa//5 ༷rdzogs 'khor sogs dge ba byas tshad gong smos 'gyur las sdu/ samyu stong du lhag par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ṭ+wāṃ~Xchilke hūṃpy-i gnyis pa chos sde 'di gang du chags pa'i gnas phun dzirdo6mo—ོgas pa'i bkod pa bshad pa ni/ 'dzam gling brnya/na pa'i lhang rta chen po pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyi rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i gnanu/ kyi rtogs/ pa brngod pa las/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus mcho skyes/ — rdorje 'chang / bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun bla ma mchogardo 4rngadabyer med snying gi pad+mor rtag bzhuganu/ nas/ gso/la 'debs lgoñtsi la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces dpal lngan bla ma dam pa rī mchog la mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas dang po phyi yi gnas kyi bkod pa ni/ ji skad du/ bkra shis dge ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can/ dbe+en zhing nyams dga' byin brlabs 39

zil chen chags/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshoges/ 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs rnams ngang gis nyung /bde gnyegs zhi khro bzhugs pa'i rdzong lnga la/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i shod kyis brten/ 'di yi ngo mtshar bkod pa 'gran du med/ phyi ltar sa 'dzin lhun chags kun nas bskor/rtsemo mthon po dgung sngon dbyings su snyegs/ baiḍūr+ya 'dra chu 'dzin bla bre bres/ de las bdud rtsi'i char zil rtag tu 'phel/spang ljang ne+e'u gseng ga yu yi maṇ+ḍa la/ rin chen me tos tshom bu'i phyur bur bkang / 'arlo byed sman gyi ljang bus ri klung khyab/shel gyi brag ri byi ru'i mdangs kyis mdzos/ dbyibs legs phug pa lha yi khang bzang 'dra/ ngo mtshar sa rdo'i khyad par ci yang brdol/ mtha' bskor ljon pa'i dga' tshal snyug po la/yid 'ong ri dwags pho ༄1 bag yangs rgyu/ dri bzang rkang 'thung bsung zhim ngad pa ldangs/ lha bya sna tshogs mgrin pa'i pi wang 40

brdung / mdzes pa'i byi'u chung skad snyan gling bu bsgyur/ dwangs bsil rnyog med 'bab chu gtsang ma'i rgyun/ lhung lhung sgra snyan sgroge cing g.yas g.yon 'bab/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i mi dang mi ma yin/ chos la dad cing dkar po'i phyogs la dga'/ sa yi dpyad legs yul gyi dge bcu tshang / zhes ji skad gsungs pa ltar rten chos sde/ 'di gang du chags pa'i rten gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i phyi yi bkod pa ni/ 'dzam gling yul dbus rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs/ bsil ldan gangs kyi rwa ba dkar pos yongs su bskor ba'i bod chen po 'di la stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ sma/da mdo khams sgang drug ru grags pa las/ phyi ma 'bri klung dang zla klung gnyis kyi bar du tshud pa'i 'bri zla zal mo sgang gi sa'i char/ sngon gli nga gi dus su gling dpon du si dang / bar sde dge'i rgyal rabs/phyis dpal yul rdzong rag chab shang zhes pa'i mnga' khongs su 4na

gtogs shing / so skye rnams kyi snang ngor mthun snang du yang rgya dkar nag gi sa dpyad kyi gzhung las ji skad gsungs pa'i sa dpyad rnyed dka' ba rnams ma tshang ba med pa'i phun sum tshogs pa/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa gzhi pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi bkod dbyibs/ phyogs mtshams kun tu bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs mtshan mas mdzes pa/ shar phyes/ lho spung /nub 'dan/ byang yol ba 'dra ba ste sa yi ka bzhi dang srung bzhi rlung rta'i lha bzhi sogs kyis legs par brgyan cing / rgyab ri rtsegasum gnam la zug 'dra/ mdun ri 'gyur med phyag rgya bsnol 'dra/ g.yas ri rin chen shel mkhar spungs 'dra/g.yon ri rgyal blon gros la 'chogs 'dra/ gsham ri dar dkar yol ba mthud 'dra/ lung phu ma sho/ mda' ma ral ba dge mtshan du mas brgyan cing / gnas 'di'i phyogs mtshams kun tu brag dang rdo la sku gzugs phyag mtshan yig 'bru phyag 42

zhabs kyi rjes la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rang byung du mas ma cimitsha/na pa med pa/ mi ma yin gdug pa can dang / gcan gzan tram̐Xcijici po'i 'tshe ba med cing / khyad par du sbrul la sogs pa'i sbyi sum̐tresrun pa'i srog chags dgon gnas 'di'i phyogs su mi rdo —rgonas pa dben zhing byin chags payin shing yul la dge bcu'i dpal yon gyis mngon par gtam/ shing mjos sdug gi bkod dbyibs skyes bus 'du byed kyis nye bar ma bskrun pa'i bkod nga/ rnams ni gnas kyi rtogs brjod las 'byung ba sngar bkod pa r+shaltar ro/ nang ltar na sbas gnas kun gyi yon tan ma lus pa glu gonas 'dir rdzogs pa'i tshul ni/ de yang gnas 'di'i rtogs rdzu lnga:de las/ nang ltar mdo khams yon tan gnas lnga 'dus/sdi gong du sku mchog 'jam dpal zhi khro'i gnas/ 'bri chen gnyan sdu ljong gang yod 'di la tshang / de 'og gsung mchog pad+ma zhi khro'i gnas/ 'dzom nang pad+ma shel phug dngos dang 'dra/ dbus su 43

thugs mchog rdor sems zhi khro'i gnas/ tsā 'dra rin chen brag dang khyad par med/ g.yon du rdzong chen che mchog yon tan gnas/ khro 'i rdo rje zil khrom bkod pa rdzogs/ g.yas 'og phrin laspordo rje phur pa'i gnas/ seng chen gnam brag ji lta ba ru bzhugs/ dbus mdun bkra shis dpal gyi de'u ni/ gnas kyi snying po sa yi 'jor bu gnyan/ myong grol rdzas chen thabs shes chu mig zung / mkha' 'gro tshogs la rol pa'i dur khrod mchog rbod gtong dregs pa drags sngags gnas rnams kyang /phyi skor rang bzhin nyid du lhun gyisagrub/ nyams dga' bag phebs rig pa shin tu dwangs/ sdod na sems spro same na ting 'dzin 'phel/ shar phyogs yang le shod dang lhor gro 'ide/ nub phyogs 'chi med tshe dang byang rnam sras/ gzhan yang khyad 'phags gnas ri'i phreng bas bskor/ ngo mtshar bkod pa du mas kun tu brgyan/ rang byung mi 'dra ched du bcos pa 'dra/44

gyinaphug la kun tshang gang 'dod lhun gyis grub zhes/ dang / gsang tsho rdzustor na shangs kyi zab lung gnyis pa 'og min gsang chen ——'kho'i pho brang dngos sa la 'phos ste/ yang de nyid kyis hūṃnosdo 'di'i rtogs bajo+od las/ gsang ba shangs kyi zab lu/nga snagelharmo pa ste/ gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang nyid dang mtshungs/ཿhūṃ0chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor dngos su bzhugs/ bla ma/ rig 'dzin ye shes sku can rnam/sa/ gshegs bzhugs bra'/ ba me long gzugs bzhin snang / bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro bco rdzi+o/—dad 'khor/ rdul gcig steng na rdul dz+nyad tshom bu bkra/ gnas ci wasnyelta dpa' bo mkha' 'gro spyin ltar 'thibs/ khyad par dus su 5rdo/tsho'is kyi 'du bar spyod/ dpal ldan ma/ hā ka la lca ma dral spri thogis/ chos gter srung mas rtag tu mel tshe mdzad/ 'ba' ka rgyal mched gsum rigs gsum mgon po yi/ yang sprul bka' sdod bdud btsan klu yi tshul/ lcam mo/ spun gsu/ma 45

kun 'khyil mched gsum 'phrul/ dkar po'i phyogs skyong sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbel/ 'chi med grub pa'i drang srong bsam gtan mdzad/ lha klu rnams kyis dus su bkur bsto byed/ sngon dus gu ru yab yum rje 'bang tshoges/ dngos su zhabs bcag sgrub gnas byin gyis brlabs/ zab mo'i gter sbas bka' srung gnyan po bskos/ bar du spyan ras gzigs dngos karma pa/ rdzu 'phrul bkod pas phebs nas sgru/ba gnas mdzad/phyis su rig 'dzin klong gsal snying pos kyang / ye shes dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis byin chen phab/ zhes ji skad gsungs pa ltar snang sems la rang dbang thob pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs shing rdzu'aphrul gyis zhabs kyis bcags pa snye/ de yang rdo rje semanu// rigs gsum mgon po/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mcho rgyal/ lha lcam man+da ra ba/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan sogs bod kyi rje 46

'bang nyer lnga/ paṇa chen bi ma mi tra sogs rgya gar paṇa grub 'ga' zhig 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po/ rgyal dbang kame pa/rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po sogs kyis gter sbas/ lha 'dre dam la btags shing / rab gnas rten bzhugs mdzad pa de rnams kyi sgrub phug dang phyag rjes zhabs rjes sogs re re bzhin da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa sba/sa gnas chen po 'di'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bkod pa yon tan mtha' dag rgyan/ sras sa la gnas pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i ljags kyis ji bzhin brjod par dka' na tshul mthong byis pas bsam brjod lī/sa 'das kyang skre rtse'i chu thig tsam kong sprul rin po che mchog gi gnas 'di'i rtogs brngod las ji ltar gsung pa bzhin kun gyi yid ches kyi rten du bkod pa lags/gsum pa/ brten pa dason sde'i byung tshul rags bsdus bshad pa la/ dang po/ gnas sgo gsar 'byed dang 47

'brel gdan sa 'di nyid thog mar phyag btab tshul gnas 'di la phyag mchod bkur bsnyi sogs byas pa'i phan yon / der bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas tshul/ bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i byung rabs bshad pa sogs brgyad las/dang po gnas sbo phyes nas dgon sde 'di ji ltar phyag btab tshul/ ni/ blo ༷se mtha' yas mchog gis/ ji skad du/pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i zhabs/ gter chen a rgyon mchog gyur gling pa bcas/ lhan rgyas phebs te bka' 'dus sgrub chen btsugs/ snod bcud ye shes chen po'i 'khor lor bsnar/ gu ru'i zhal/ bstan snyan brgyud gdams pa gsan/sprul pa'i brda yig shog ser gtan la phab/ zab mo'i gter bzhes gnas zhal 'byed pa sogs// bstan 'gror phan bde rgyas pa'i rten 'byung shar/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon nas rje nyid la rtsa'adra rin chen brag dang / rdzong shod bde gshegs 48

'dus pa'i pho brang gnyis char thog mar gnas yin pa'i gsal snang byung yang ska/bas su ma bab/ phyis sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pas gnas yi ga dang gnas sgo 'byed par bskul ma gnang ba dang / gnas chen nyer lnga'i mdo byang dpa' brag nas bzhes pa'i rkyen dang / a rgyan chen po'i lung don dus su khel ba bcas las rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me yos le'i bod zla gnyis pa'i nang gnas zhal 'byed par sanang ba'i skabs ma bgros rten 'brel gyi dbang sis lhan cig dus sacis tu kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po dang /gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pa/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha'ayas bcas gdan 'dzom/ sgrub gnas chen po'i gnas zhal legs par phyes te bde gnyegs kun 'dus bka' brgyad kyi sgrub pa grub pa'i rjes thog der/ sater chen rnam pa gnyis nas tsit+ta gsang phug tu chos khri mthon por 'jam mgon bla ma 49

bzhugs su gsol zhing / sku gsung thugs rten/ rin chen dang po'i maṇ+ḍal bcas bstsal nas mtshan brjod par dka' ba nges pa don gyi slad du mchan nas smos na/ a rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pas gsol ba'i mtshan 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yu drung gling pa'o zhes mnga' gsol/ zhing / dril chen bsgrags/ phyin chad mtshan de ltar 'dogs pa dang / zab gter gyi rten 'brel nyams pa sor chud dgos pa'i gsung nan bcas zhabs brtan 'bul gnang mdzad pa sogs bstan 'gror dge ba'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar rab tu phye bar mdzad do/ gdan sa 'di nyid thog mar phyag ji ltar btab tshul yang / 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yu drung gling pa'i zhal nas/ ji skad du/ deng sang kha ba' rgyal khams spyi bye brag bde legs bcas su sgrub pa'i khang bzang dang / sku gsung thugs rten gnad du 'gro ba bzhengs/sa yi me btsa' lung dang mthun par btab/ zhes gsungs pa 50

bzhin du mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga'i nang gses yon tan gnas lnga gcig bsdus samayan tan gyiyan tan gyi gnas rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen mo/ 'dir dgon pa zhig btab na rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang / bye brag tu yangs pa'i rgyol khams kun tu lo phyugs legs shing char chu dus su 'be+eb pa mi nad phyugs nad zhi ba dang / lhag par khul 'di'i dus ngan gyi rgud pa mtha' dag zhi ba sogs la/ phan nges a rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bka' lung ltar 'jam mgon bla ma nyid nas rgyu phyung mdzad nas sa gnad me btsa'i gtsug lag khang dpal sprung sku tshab pas me glang lor rmang gting ste rten dang brten pa bcas mtha' rgyas grub dge 'dun gyi sde 'debs par mdzad pa dang / snga 'gyur bka' gter sgrub chen brgya lhag tsam mdzad pa rnams tshugs grol gyi skabs phal cher 'ja' tshon khyad par can shar ba dang / sman sgrub mdzad pa'i skabs 'ga' rer 5

sman gyi dri ngad rbong ring nas chor ba dang / chogs kyi 'du ba'i skabs su 'ja' 'od dang / bya rgod mang po tshesags la rol ba dang / bdud bamikhol shing / rak+ta phyur ba sogs der 'dus pa thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub pa dang / sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ring bsrel la mchod pa mdzad pa'i nyin sngar mthong ma myong ba'i 'ja' 'od thig les nam mkha' gang ba sogs kun gyi spyod yul du gyur/ a rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i lung don ltar rdzong shod sogs gnas chen rnams su rtsagasum dgongs 'dus gter sgrub dang 'brel tshig bdun gsol 'debs sgrub pa mdzad skabs/ zla ba gnyis ring nyin mtshan phal cher mtshan thun dang po rnams su 'ja' sprin bkra shis pa'i rtags kyi rnam pa can mang po shar bas de don ma shes pa/'i rtog dpyo+od can rnams kyis 'di lo'i ltas 'di gang la blta zhes the tshom gling brjod byed dgos pa byung ba sogs ches mang ngo /52

gnas 'di la phyag mchod bkur snyi sogs byed na phan yon khyad par can yod tshul yang / 'jam mgon rin po che nyid kyi zhal nas/ rgyal bas bsngags pa'i dbe+en gnas nyams re dga'/ snying nas dam chos sgrub pa'i gnas su bzang / rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i rkyen dang rgyang thag ring / bsam gtan bsgom na ting 'dzin 'di ru 'phel/ gnas kyi gang zag byin gyis rlobs par nus/ bsnyen sgrub 'dod na chu shing mthun rkyen bzang / ra/tha' gnyinu/ spangs pa'i banu+o/da snyor/sa/ btsawa/ ba sla/ chogs 'khor bskor na mkha' spyod gsang lam bgrod/tshongags mchod tsam /)sa bsod nams chogs chen rdzogs/snyems byed gcod na char slong 'grig par sla/ tho char phul/ na dus min 'chi las thar/ phyag bskor byas na nad gdon sdig sgrib byang / dar lcog rlung rtas bsod nams dbang thang rgyas/dge sdig gang byas 'bum phrag nyid du 'gyur/ dad pas 'brel 53

thog tsam yang don dang ldan/ ngo mtshar rmad byung gnas mchog khyad par can/ ya mtshan tshul la phyogs tsam bstod pa'i mthus/ rtsagasum rgyal ba dbyings nas thugs dgyes te/dbang dang byin brlabs dngos grub char ltar phabs/ srung ma mnyes pa'i dge mtshan 'dzum zer gyis/ nyin dang mtshan mor bu bzhin rtag tu skyong/ mi lus thob kyang dud 'gro'i sems ldan rnams/ yon tan thos nas dad pa rnyed gyur cig che ba'i snyan grags phyogs su khyab pa yis/ kun kyang mos gus snang ba 'phel byed shog ces gsungs pa ltar don la mi bslu nges pas dad ldan skal bzang ser skyayangs nas de don blang dor ma 'khyugs par mdzad rgyu gal che bar sems so/gnyis pa mdo khams gdan sa chen mo shar rgyal ba dpal spungs dgon pa'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i dgon 'dir bzhad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi bstan pa rin po che ji ltar dar zhing 54

rgyas tshul bsdus tsam ngo ༷de zhu ba la/ dgon 'dir bshad grwa zhes pa dngos su zur 'dzugs ma sanang yang / gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta khong gi dus nas bzung da lta'i bar du bod khams stod smad bar gsum gyi sa dge bka' rnying ris med skyes chen bu slob kyi tshogs ma bos ngang gis 'du ba rnams la so mo'i mos 'dun ltar sum rtags dag gsum/ sgra ka tsan dbyangs gsum/ sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag gso rig rgyud bzhi/rtsis dkar nag bzo ris bris 'bur/ gzhal yas khang si thig rtsa/ mngon brjod sogs thun mong rig gnas sna chogs rnams dang / nang rig pa thun mong mdo sare la/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang / rgyud bla ma/ dbu ma rigs chogs rnams dang 'jug pa/ mngon pa mtshod sogs gzhung bka' pod lnga cha tshang dang /thun min sngags skor la/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyung 'grel dang / bde mchog rtsa'agrel/ rgyud brtag gnyis/ phur 55

pa rtsadum/ 'jam dpal mtshan brdzod/ rtsargyud gsang ba snying po/ man ngag lta phreng / gsang sngags lam rim gyi bshad khrid bcas gzhan la 'chad spel gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan nyi ma shar ba lta bu dar rgyas su gyur/ sgrub khang gsar bzhengs dang 'brel sgrub pa'i bstan pa thog mar ji ltar dar rgyas su song tshul yang /thol mar rje nyid nas rdzi bo 'ig la khyod la ming ci zer dris pas phun tshogs dang / khyim tshang su yin dris pas dge lung tshang dang / ser/nu/ can du yodadris/ panu/ ra/dzo sa bzang po bdun yod zer ba la brten nas rten 'brel legs 'grigs byung ba dang /nyid la rag chab shog dpon gyis khos kyang grogs byed zer bas mthun rkyen legs 'dzom gyis sgrub khang bzhengs rgyu'i thugs thag bcad nas de byung dngos rdzas rnams la brten rab byung bcu bzhi pa sa stag lor dbu btsugs nas sgrub grwa'i lha khang dang grwa shag bdun bcas legs/ par grub/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis sna 56

sel nas brtsams ste lo gsum zla gsum gyi bar du mtshams kyi bug ral spangs te bsnyen bsgrub nyams len dang / zla re bzhin dus mchod/ nyin re bzhin du thun bzhi bcas dpal spungs yang khrod rtsa 'dra'i bca' yig bzhin zhib par lag bstar bgyis te tshul bzhin sgrub pa mdzad pas mkhas grub kyi 'byung gnas lta bur gyur pas mtshon 'brel tshad don ldan du gyur to/ yang khrod bca' yig rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum du yo/da pas zhib par der gzigs par 'tshal lo/gsum pa gdan sa 'dir rgyal bstan bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor los 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang ba'i dam pa'i skyes bu 'ga' yi byung tshul rags bsdus 'god pa la/ gdan sa 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po kun mkhyen pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas sam 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yu drung gling pa mchog gi sku phreng rim byon gyi mdzad rnam bsdunu/ tsam 'god pa 57

dang / gzhan gdan sa 'dir bla sprul kha gcig gis byung rabs bsdus tsam bshad pa gnyis las/dang po kho sprul rin po che'i sku phreng rim byon gyi mdzad rnam bsdus tsam 'god pa la/ de yang spyir 'jam mgon mkhyen kong mchog gsum gnas 'dir gdan 'dzom nas lhan rgyas kyis gnas sgo gsar du phyes ris med bstan 'gro'i don du thugs smon mdzad pas bskyangs kyang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtsedabang po dang / gter chen mchog gyur gling pa gnyis kyi mdzad rnam 'dir ma bris pas gzhan du gzigs par 'tshal/ 'dir gangs can gyi ljongs su mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu byung ba'i nang nas 'gran zla dang bral ba gdan sa 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po 'jam mgon blo ༷le mtha' yas mchog gi mdzad rnam snying bsdus ni/ ston pa nyid kyis/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /gang gi lag na ting 'dzin 58

mchogarabod pa/ /nyu(5 ba byams pa grags pa mtha' yas bzhin//sems can rnams kyi don mang byed 'gyur zhes/ /blo gros mtha'ayas de ni ngas lung bstan/ zhes dang / laṅkar gshegs pa las/ /de yi 'og tu byas dus la/ /'adz+ren pa blo gros zhes bya ba/ khes bya lnga rnams rwoṭā+o na pa po/ /dpa' bo chen po 'byung bar 'gyur / zhes dang / nge bzhin du phal po che dang /ye shes phyag rgya'i mdo soges mdo sde du ma las lung bstan cing / gzhan ya/nga rgyud dang / gter kha tra/sar rnying du ma nas lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa ltar/ ston pa'e nye gnas kun dga' bo/ rnam snang sprul pa'i lo chin bī ro tsa na zung gi rol gar nyid/ rje btsun mi la dang khyung po nel 'byor sogs mkhas grub skyes chen mtha' yas pa byon pa'i gdung las/ yab khyung po bla ma g.yu drung bstan 'dzin dang / yum bkra shis mcho bya ba'i sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo bya yi lo zla ba bcu pa'i 59

tshes bcu'i nyi shar la/ gnas mchog pad+ma lha rtse'i mdun du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te yum la gnod pa med par sku 'khrungs/ ka kha tsam yang ma bslab pa'i gong dgung grangs bzhi pa'i thog nas 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs rang rdol du gsungs pa dang / byis pa'i rtser tshun du dbang bskur ba/chos bshad pa/ lha khang bzhengs pa rang nyid gu ru'i rnam 'phrul du zhal gyis bzhes pa so/gas dam pa'i rnam thar sgrib med du gsal/ dgung ngo/ lnga pa nas yi ge'i phyi mo logos gsan bsam brda bstan pa tsam gyis thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu yas mas nas dam pa'i chos dang zab gter gyi bag chags sad de dam pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i thugs dam brtan/ gnas lnga ris pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta ze chen 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtsedabang po/ byams mgon tā yi si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po 60

sogs ris med kyi bshes gnyen bcu phrag lnga lhag gi drung nas sgrub brgyud shi rta brgyad kyi lam srol gangs can ljongs su mchis so 'tshal gyi smin grol gdams pa'i zab bcud mtha' dag rdzogs par gsan/ bka' dang bstan bcos rgyud lung man ngag gi gzhung bshad zhal shes las tshongags phyag len phra zhib dang bcas thugs kyi bum par bskyil nas/ gsan bsam sgom pa'i phyag rjenu/ rmad du byung ba'i bstan bcos kyang mdzod chen rnam pa lnga sa mtshoni pa'i gsung rab glegs bam dgu bcur langs pa'i rnam thar la gzhig na sku tshe de nyid du rtsom pa rkyang pa mdzad pa lta bu/ bka' gter gsar rnying dbang khrid man ngag lung sogs kyi 'chad spel la bsam na skutsho der 'chad spel sha stag mdzad lta bu/ dkyil 'khor rab byams bsam gyis mi/ khyab pa'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams bzhes mdzad tshul la brtag na sku tshe'i ring sgrub khang 'dag sbyar gyis bzhugs pa lta 61

bu/ gdan sa dang po tsā 'dra rin chen brag dang / gdan sa gnyis pa rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen mo phyag btab cing rten dang brten pa bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsar du bzhengs pa/ tshom bu tshoges sgrub kyi sgrub chen brgya phrag phyed gnyis las barbas ba/ dkon mchog gi mchod 'bul/ dge 'dun la bsgen bkur sogs mdor na chos spyod rnam pa bcu yi phyag rjes la gzhal na sku tshe de nyid la bya ba las kyi 'khor lar brtson nas bzhugs pa lta bu ste nges par 'phags pa'i spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig go/ lhag par gter gyi bka' bab pas gter chen mchog gyur gling pa sogs lhan rgyas nas gter kha mang du bzhes/ khyad par zab gteragyi lung byang du sku tshe thung ngu zhig las med par gsal yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang rtsa rlung gi nus pas sku tshe phyir bsrings te dgung grangs brgyad bcu gya bdun gyi steng du son 62

kyang sku gzhon sha chags shing spyan slar gsal ba sogs grub rtags nang gi che ba mngon sum mtshan ma 'o/ tshul de lta bu'i dngos kyi mdzad pa re zhig mthar phyin te dgung grangs gya bdun pa sa phag mgo zla ba'i tshes nyer bdun nam gung tsam la ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas te sku'i bkod pa nub phyogs shān+ta pu rerardapa' bo cadi pa'i dum bu rtsal gyi thugs kar thim pa'i tshul bstan cing / gang 'dul gdul bya'i skal ba 'tshams pa'i rnam 'phrul tshad med pas/ 'khor ba ma stong bi bar du 'gro ba'i don rtag khyab lhun grub tu mdzad pa dang / khyad par skal bzang 'di'i rnam 'dren stong gi tha mar bde gshegs mos pa rab snang du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te sangs rgyas snga ma rnams kyi sku cho dang mdzad phrin mtha' dag bdag gir bzhes te/da lta'i dus kyimi mjed zhing 'di'i 'gro ba 'bu srin phra mo yan chad kyang rnam grol gsum gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa ni 63

phyug rgyal mchog bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i chos dang rigs kyi sras yum rigs ldan ṭ+wāṃk+ki bde skyid dbang mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing pho 'brug gi lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs mdo rgyud gzhung lugs spyi dang khyad par du mdzode chen rnam pa lnga dang / thun min mnyam med shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi thabs lam ni gu chos drug dang /grol lam phyag 41 chen po bcas la gsan bsam nyams bzhes mthar phyin pa mdzad nas don brgyud kyi rtogs pa brnyes te rgyal mchog bcu drug pa'i rigs kyi bdag por gyur/ gzhan yang rin chen gter gyi mdzod sogs gsar rnying ris med kyi dbang lung lan grangs du mar 'chad spel dang / tsā 'dra rin chen bragardzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa sogs su bstan 'gro'i mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs te/ dgung grangs lnga bcu pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sbrul lor khra legs kyi ri khrod du gzugs sku chos 66

dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to/yang 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i sku skye de ma thag pa gcig ni las smon gyis bskul nas chab mdo ri bo che'i phyogs su rim bzhin zhabs sor bskyod nas dpal ldan shangs pa'i brgyud 'dzin mtshong kha dgon gsar du phyag btab nas de phyogs su bshad sgrub kyi bya ba rgya cher ma/dzad tshul dang de'i yang srid da lta sku 'cho bzhes thog bstan 'gre'i don brlabs chen mdzad bzhin pa'i tshul rnams 'dir ma spros so/dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer ni yongs grags twar sras kong sprul mchog gi sku skye de ma thag pa kong sprul sku phreng gsum pa karma blo ༷se chos kyi seng ge ni/ rje gong ma dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis 'da' kha'i zhal chems su spru/la sku yul dbus su yong / yul/ khyim/ lo dus pha ma sogos karma pa bcu drug pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i lung ston par 67

'gyur zhes bka' stsa la/ ba ltar/ gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / rgyal dbang karma pa gnyis kyis sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs pa'i lung don ltar gangs ljongs phyag na pasdu'i chos srid kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bsnyi gnas yul dbus lha ldan du khyim bdag che rigs dang 'byor pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i grags snyan ldan pa sa 'du tshang yab tshe ring stobs rgyal dang / yum gzhung sa chen po'i bka'i mdun na 'don sa dbang nga phod kyi sras mo pad+ma g.yu sgron gnyis kyi myu gur rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing phorta'i lo'i tshes gcig gi nyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad/ dgung grangs gcig dang zla ba lnga bzhes skabs na bza' dang mtshan gsol/ dgung grangs drug bzhes par karma pa mchog gi 'bras ljongs rum btegs sprul pa'i pho brang du mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas bzung tho+oladabang karla/ pa/ khra 'gu mkhan chen/ ka lu rin po68

che sogs kyi mdun nas thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan bsam dpyis phyin par mdzad/gzhan dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi gser chos rnam pa lnga dang / dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs rin chen gter gyi mjod sogs gsar rnying gi smin grol mtha' yas pa la rang don du thos bsam/ gzhan don du 'chad spel gyi sgo nas rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu'i bstan 'gro spyi dang / bye bras tu rdzong shod dgon 'dir gtsug lag khang bskyar bzhengs kyi bstan rtsadangos rdzas dang / sku gsung thugs rten bcas gnang /gzhan yang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la/ mdzad phrin rgyas bzhin dgung grangs sum bcu rtsadagu rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu sprel lo'i bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu bzhi nyin bstan 'gro spyi bye'i gegs chags kyis blo bur du dgongs pa zhi bar gshegs shor ba skyesan no/69

sku phreng bzhi pa ni yul dbus lha lngan sge mo ra sa thog yab rang bzhin bzang ba'i mgon po dang / yum ṅgā ki dbyangs can gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bdun pa'i nang dpal rgyal dbang karma pa bcu bdun pa mchog gis sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs pas 'jam mgon kong sprul blo ༷se chos kyi seng ge'i yang srid 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin mdzad nas mnga' gsol gzengs bstod dang bcas deng skabs bstan 'gro'i don du sku 'asnang bzhin bzhugs pa lags soganyis pa gdan sa 'di'i bla sprul kha gcig gi byung rabs bsdus tsam bshad pa la deyang gdan sa 'di 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i bla sprul rim byon ni bstan pa'i bdag po de nyid kyibaka' lung ltar des chung bla ma dge legs nas sgrub khang gsar bzhengs kyi la/sa grwa'i 'go 'dzin pa sogs bstan pa 'di nyid tshul bzhin du 'dzin skyong gnang / gzhan yang khyung po tshe0

rin chen dang / hor bla ma bstan lu/ dge dgyes thar mchog65ba bse mkhan rgan sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams dang /dpal sprung nas bla bkos phebs pa mgar ra phan bde/ gso gzhung mthar phyin rnam gnyis/ lhag par du mchog sprul rin po che tshul khrim/sa ni/ hor khog ra stag steng du sku 'khrungs shing /rgyal dbang karma pas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ 'dir thog mar dpon ru chos grags kyis gdan drangs/ rje mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis dgon 'dir bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gso/la/gzengs bstod rgya cher mdzad/ khong gis nyer sras lha khang bzhengs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don yun ring du rgya cher bskyangs mthar dpalayāl rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ gzhan yang sgo nya mkhan po sogs kyis kyang bstan 'gror sman nges kyi mdzad pas 71

bskyangs bar ma zad sngon gyi bla ma rim byon phal mo ches kyang bstan dgon 'di la gces spras dang 'dzin spel tshul bzhin du ba4)sa pa lags so/bzhi pa gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas ji ltar bzhugs tshul ni/ gtsug lag khang chen nang du lha bzo bsod nams rin chen zhes pas rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas bzhengs par grags pa'i shākya thub pa thog tshad/ byams pa thog tshad/gu ru thog tshad dang rdo rje sems dpa' thog tshad/ bde gshegs so lnga li ma/ gnas brtan bcu drug rgyal chen sde bzhi/ dze+e bha la bcas dang/ log bris bla ma dang yi dam skor/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ byang sems nyan rang chos skyong sogs gser bris tshad ldan/ gu ru lha/ khang du rje nyid nas sa 'dul gyi ched phyag bzo 'dams las grub pa'i thog tshad can gyi shin tu byin ldan gyis gatshos/ gter ma'i gu ru dang / li ma'i gu ru/ zangs 72

gser gyi gu ru sogs sku che chung brgya phrag las lhag pa bzhugs/ sgrub grwa'i yang dag tshosnags khang nang du a rgyan za hor ma 'khor bla ma yi dam bcas pa/ 'od dpag med/rgyal ba rgya mtshong/ thub pa/ rigs gsum mgon po/ sgrol ma dkar sngon gnyis/ gsang thig yang dag skor gsum/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug so/gas sku gzugs che chung mang du bzhugs/ dwags pa lha khang du/ b.la' brgyud mar mi dwags/ gsum lder bzo che legs/ gzhan ya nga bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad kyi gtso che ba'i bla ma rnams kyi sku gzugs/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi 'dra sku sogs bla sku che chung du ma bzhugs/ nyer sras lha khang nang du nyer sras brgyad kyis gcos byang sems kyi sku gzugs du ma/ ba7'a 'gyur lha khang nang du/bka' 'gyur gatshos gsung rten skor dang / shangs pa'i bla rabs kyaisku brnyan sosas mang du bzhugs/ mgon khang nang du 73

mgon dkar li ma spus legs dang / lder bzo myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa bka' sdod bzhi dang bcas pa/gzhan yang mgon po ber nag can mgon po legs ldan/ phyag bzhi pa/ tshoges bdag ma ning sogs gsar rnying gi chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams la nang bzhugs tshad ldan yod pa bzhugs/ rje yi gzims khang nang du tshe lha rnam gsum li ma khyad 'phags/ grub chen sa ra ha li ma spus legs/ bye ma'i a krum las grub pa'i jo go a ti sha/ sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma/'od dpag med/ tshe dpag med/ kong sprul sku 'dra zangs gser las grub pa nga 'dra ma/ rgyal ba rgya masnang/ rdor sems/sgrol dkar/ sman bla mched brgyad/ sangs rgyas rab bdun/gu ru ste de rnams gter ma dang li ma zangs gser sogs las grub pa yin/ gzhan yang ba so dang tsan+dan dkar dmar sogs las grub pa'i sku gzugs che phra ci rigs du ma dang / sgrub 74

brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi gtso che ba'i bla ma rnams kyi sku brnyan/phag mo grub pa'i sku 'dams las grub pa shin tu ngo mtshar can rje nyid byon skabs dbu zhwa phud mkhan zhig yod par grags/pad+ma saṃ glawa sogs de rnams ga༄ mosku khyad 'phags rnamasayin/gzhan yang sku gzugs che chung brgya phrag du ma zhig mchis/ rje nyid kyi sku 'bum dang / zhal thang skor la/ bde chen zhing thang che chung gsum/ rgyud sde lnga'i zhal thang / si tu chos 'byung zhal thang / bka' brgyad/ gu drag zhal thang / bka' gdams zhal thang / zhi khro'i zhal thang / sgrol ljang zhal thang / phyag drug zhal thang / rtsagasum dgongs 'dus zhal thang cha tshang / mdzad bcu'i zhal thang / sangs rgyas stong sku/ rdor sems stong sku/bka' brgyud gser phreng zhal thang cha tshang / shangs pa'i bla ma yi dam zhal thang / phyag chen sngon 'gro'i zhal thang / ma gcig tshogs zhing zhal thang / skye rgang rta mgrin zhal thang / 'dzam 75

gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhal thang / tshe lha rnam gsum zhal thang / gu ru mtshan brgyad zhal thang / mgon chen sde lnga'i zhal thang / dur khrod bdag mo'i zhal thang / tshe ring mched lnga'i zhal thang sogs zhal thang spus legs che chung lnga brgya lhag bzhugs/ 'di rnams phal cher bka' gdams pa'i phyag bzo dang karma sgar bris yin/ gsung rten skor la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum/ rin chen gter mdzod/ gdams ngag mdzod bka' brgyud sngags mdzod/ shes bya kun khyab mdzod/ rgya chen bka' mdzod/ rnying ma'i bka' ma/ mkhyen kong mchog gsum gyi zab chos cha tshang /'don chog gi rigs sogs skya pod sum stong lnga brgya lhag tsam bzhugs/ thugs rten skor mchod rten te lha bab mchod rten/bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten/ pad spungs mchod rten/ myang 'das mchod rten/ byang chub mchod rten/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/76

dge 'dun dbyen sdum mchod rten/ cho 'phrul mchod rten sogs gsir dngul zangs rag gi mchod rten che chung mang tsam dang /gzhan yang dgon gyi mtha' skor rnams su mchod rten mang du mchis / mchod pa'i yo byad kyi skor ni/ gser dngul khra sdeb dang / dngul rkyang / zangs rag 'adz+res/ ma/ zangs rkyang bcas skyi+o mchod chas/ gser dngul khra sdeb kyi maṇ+ḍal che chung lnga/ ba so dang rus pa sogs kyi risas lnga dang / pang khebs/ zhwa ser lnga bcu lhag 'khrol lo che chung sasum / gser dngul khra sdeb kyi mtshan thub spus legs cha nyer lnga / kong bu mar me rgyun 'bar/ rol mo'i rigs che chung du ma/ rab gnas skor dang bsgral chas skor sna 'dzom/ zangs rag li bcas kyi bdun tshar brgya phras/ du ma/ 'khar rnga khams gsum 'brug grags gcos 'khar rnga che chung gnyis/ gser rnga dang bsgrig lnga sum cu lhag rkang gling cha lnga/ gser gling gtsos gling cha bzhi/77

dngul zangs khra sdeb kyi dung dmar gcos dung cha drug ting shag che chung bdun/ dril bu lnga bcu lhag ba so dang tsan+dan sogs las grub pa'i ṭ+wāṃ ru bco lnga lhag sil snyan spus legs cha bcu lhag dkyil 'khor chas/ 'chams chas 'phan gdugs/ phye phur grangs mang / tshogs zangs che chung bdun/gur mo che gcigazo khra sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa yod do/ /lnga pa tshes dus mchod kyi skor ni/ bod zla dang po rā 'phrul dus chen la tshes lnga nas bzung grub thob bka' brgyad nyin bdun ring nyin re bzhin tshogs brgya re/ tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga gnyis la nyer sras brgyad kyi cho ga dang / sman chogade'i bcu bzhi dgung mor mtshan thog thag tu rje btsun mi la'i 'das mchod du bka' brgyud mgur marlo gsung / gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la sgar bas/nga bya la dgun bca' grol/ tshes tshe8

gnyis la gtang rag gi tshul du mkha' 'gro'i bro rar 'khor 'das mchod pa bya/ bcu gnyis bar du bcu shog res mos kyis rgyun 'dug bya srol/ bdag cag gi ston pa sku 'khrungs pa/ sangs rgyas pa/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa ste dus chen sum 'dzoms sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bzung ste bcu gcig bar dri med kun dga'i rgyal ba rgya mcho rgyal tho rgyan bkod dngos gzhi dbang bskur gtang rag bcas sgrub chen tshogs/ nyi ma byang bgrod skabs bla ma nor lha'i sgrub pa khog phub dpal chen ma dang 'brel ba'i g.yang sgru/ba nyin gcig bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin 'dzam gling spyi bsang skabs dpal de'u la ri bstod bsang mchod gter gsar rgyal brngan/thugs sgrub tshogs mchod bcas nyin gcig gsung / drug pa'i tshes gcig nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo nyin brgyad tshongags skabs rag chab dgon gyi bla grwa rnams kyang gsung 79

mkhan 'ong dgos/ de skabs dgon ltag 'og gnyis kyi bla grwa yongs nas bka' 'gyur bklag rgyu'i rgyug sprad dgos pas rgyug 'phrod pa thams cad tshogs la zhus/sa/ ma 'phrod pa'i rigs rnams phyag 'bebs dang bcas phyir log dgose/ bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga nas brgyad pa'i gnam stong bar dbyar gnas zla ba phyed gnyis tshogos dgos/ dgun nyi ldog skabs sher snying bdud bzlog bya/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung bca' bsang gter gsar rgyal brngan dadabyen bca' zla gsum bzhugs/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga gnyis la rdor sems sgru/ba mchod dang / tshes nyi shu gcig nas 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa'i 'das mchod/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub chen nyin bdun tshogs/ yang tshes nyi shu brgyad dang nyer dgu gnyis la mgon be ber nag gi dgu gtor tshogs dgos/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nas kar gling 80

zhi khro'i sgrub pa nyin bdun chogs/ yang tshes nyi shu gsum nas mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub chen btsugs nas gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tshos gcig tho rengs ser phreng dang bcas khang steng la gtor 'bul bkyag nas tshogs grol/ gnam lo'i dga' ston bya/ nya stong tshes brgyad kyi dus mchod ni/ tshes brgyad theg chen gso stong / yar ngo'i tshes bcur dkon mchog spyi 'dus/tshes bco lnga la gzhi gsum gso :de / mar ngo'i tshes bcu la/ gsang thig yab bka' dang / yum bka' res mos/ gnam stong la gzhi gsum gso 11 bcas kyi rgyun tshogs rnams chad lus med pa 'don dgos / zhib cha bca' yig las gsal bas 'dir ma smos so/drug pa dgon 'di'i gnas lag dang sde 'khor ni/spyir rgya gar yul du gnas chen nyi shu sogs dang / bod kyi yul 'dir stod smad bar gsum du gnas chen mang du bzhugs 81

pa las/ bye brag mdo smad 'diraganas chen nyer lngar mchis pa'e ya gyal yon tan gye gnas lnga gcig tu 'dus pa'i sbas gnas chen po ljong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gnas kyi gtso bo ni gong gsal gnas yig ltar/ 'jam dpal sku yi gnas/pad+ma gsung gi gnas/ yang dag thugs kyi gnas/ che mchog yon tan gyi gnas sam bdud brtsi'ithon tan gyi gnas/ phur pa phrin las kyi gnas/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi gnas/ ma mo rbod gtong gi gnas/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi gnas/ 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi gnas te sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gnas dang / dbus su sde brgyad mchod rten brtsegs pa'i mkhar/ rgya nag ri bo rtselnga'i gnas/ rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad kyi gnas/rigs gsum mgon po'i gnas/ rgya gar dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas sogs yod la/ de lta bu'i gnas mchog khyad par can 'di yi gnas yig tu gsal ba'i gnas kyi yan lag shar 82

phyogs a ri'i nang du dpal chen dgyes pa'i pho brang yang le shod gnyis pa/ lho phyogs su gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyi gnas khang dmar mdo brag dmar zangs yag nam mkha' rdzong / nub phyogs su tshe dpag med kyi gnas ri bo dbang gzhu'i snying po bkra shis zla gam phug byang phyogs su gnod sbyon nor lha'i gnas 'ba' rgyal 'khol ri mched gsum bcas yan lag gi pa gnas/ bzhi dang / 'dzin khra bo zhung lung / dngul mkhar dpa' 'bur mo brag gter lung so brag ma/ ra 'dzam rag ldi nang /rag cog nyag pa gnyen po/ 'dzi smad mkha' 'gro sher phuganyin lhung g.yu lung shel brag la sogs mtha' bskor na gnas lag du ma'i phreng bas bskor ba yin no/ gnas kyi srung ma yang rje nyid kyi gnas bsang las/ gnas 'dir srung ma'i gtso bo lha chen po/ /dpal mgon phyag bzhi lcam dral 'khor dang bcas//drang srong brgyad dang gdong mo mched sde bzhi/ dmar nag dam 83

can nor gyi bdag po dang / /dur khrod bdag pos rtag tu srung ma/ mdzad/ /sman btsun mched lnga bdud mgon ya/ba yum 'khor//'ba' rgyal mched gsum lcam mo spun gsum bcas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas gter srung ma la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / yul gyi zo sa ni/ lha yi dge bsnyen dkar brag rdo go khra tshang gnyen po/ dge bsnyen so kha/ gnas srung rag khram/dpal ldan ni co rgyal mo/ yul srung stag spyi rgyal mo seges sngon slob dpon pad+mas bka' bsgos dam btags mdzad nas bstan pa tshul bzhin sru nga bar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i dkar phyogs kyi srung ma rnams so/sde 'khor dang grwa zhabs ni/ bod sde pa gzhung gi bka' lung ltar rag chab rdzong shog chen spyi nang nas lhag pa sger chod yin pas grwa mang tsam yod re re bzhin mtshan ma smos la/ shod ldog rko 'gugs karma sogs 'dzing shog khag bdun 84

nang sgyu lus tsha tha bu karma dam chos bzang po/ nor pa spang sngo bu karma dge 'dun dar rgyas/ spe lung mkhas sgang bu karma brtson 'grus dar rgyas/ nyin lhung bon khro bu karma shes rab grags pa/bya khyung bu karma sbyin pa mthar phyin/ khams thang grwa karma rin chen tshe dbang / sag snying rgya bye tshang grwa gcig rag chab shog kha bzhi nang / bco chen bu kame bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ phar me rta lo bu karma dkon mchog stang sasal rta pho bu grwa karma/ yi/ khams/ tshang grwa gcig zhang sgas bu karma bstan pa sogs rnga sna phral 'brog nor dkar bu karma shes rab dbang rgyal/ rang srung bu karma rnam rgyal/ sog chung bu a dkar bkra shis nu+o/gas nyer mchod sogs 'khor dud bco lnga/ rdzong shod rang 'khor san ru sde pa bcas sde 'khor dang grwa zhabs yin pa'i bka' tham nga/ lta'ang mjal rgyu la/ chogs zhugs mang skabs gzhi byes bla sprul sum brgya lhag dang / nyung ma/thar yang nyer lnga yod do/85

dgon pa'i yong 'bab sa/ 'ing ni/ sngon rgya mkhar jo mome sa go do rta khang dang / mdzo ra mda'/ rta thang khog bcas rje si tu chos 'byung la phul ba yi/na pas dpal spung gzhung sa rtsod med yin la de nas kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshongs sa gnyis brjes nas bzung rdzong shod dgon gyis dbang ba'i sa dang/ sa gzhan lhag go do rta khang yan chod dang sa ngan ma ṇi rdo 'bum tshun chod/gter lung brag mchod rtsim yan chod dang / gyang 'be lu ma'i zhing ring yan chod/ 'dzin ba yi lcang rgan chun chod dang / sgo theg pha wang sba 'dra ma yan chod/ ngo shes mtsher can ma tshun chod/shod ldog chu sri brag 'gag yan chod sogs dgon 'di'i sa yin te bod gzhung dang sde dge chos rgyal rim byon bcas nas gnang ba'i bka' lung 'ja' sdig kha sprod dang /she tham bcas da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ sa de dag dgon rang ma gtogs gzhan spyod mkhan byung tshe saser srang lnga yi chad pa sogs gang 86

'os gcod chog pa sa skyong sde dge'i bka' lung ltar lag bstar gnang srol yod/ dgon pa'i zhing dang rtswa mtsher bcas mched thebs kyi phyir duyin pas mchog dman su thad nas log sgrub sna gcig kyang mi chog gal srid 'gal ba byed mkhan byung tshe sa gnas sa sa' 'go pa rnams kyis zhib bltas tshul mthun las/ mi ngo rgyu ngo blta ba dang / rang gar btang snyoms su gtan nas bzhag mi chog de las 'gal ba 'go khrid dang 'og sde sus thad nas byung phyin dngul srang nyer lnga nas/ lnga bcu bar gyi chad pa'i 'ba' 'gal yin pa'i sbrug tham dgon rang gi nang du mjal rgyu da ltayangayad do/ gter lung dbon rgang ngag dbang sa zhing / gter lung sbos rgan sa zhing / lhag grwa rnams kyi sa zhing / shes rab stod smad cha tshang / rag chab bco chen sa zhing / rta pho sa zhing / gad thog sa zhing / rta lo 'khor sdom sa zhing cha tshang / lhag pa'i khams stong shod sa zhing chung ba/87

'dzin lhun po rtserdo smo zhing khang cha tshang / 'dzin spyad sbam sa zhing / gzhan yang yod she ma nor khag nas 'bri res mar bod rgya bzhi re/ tshe 'bar dang mtshams phog mchod thebs su rang 'khor dpon ru nas smrad dgos pa yin no/ spyi ba ni/ lhun grub steng khag brgyad kyi spyi ba phog 'phel yod pa'i dud chen rnams phud/ de 'phros rag chab 'go dud bcas nas spyi ba mi drug res lo bdun re bzung res byed dgos pas rten rgyu/ ma rtsadang bcas rtsis sprod chad lus med pa byed dgos pa las chad lus byung tshe sa skyong sde dge nas nyes chad yong nges yin no/bdun pa dgon 'di'i bsgrigs srol bca' yig khag gcig phyogs bsdus byas na/ de yang rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang 'dir dgon pa zhig btab na bstan 'gro spyi sger gyi ṭa/da pa mtha' dag zhi ba dang rgyal khams kun la phan bde'i nyi ma 'char bar a rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i lung don 88

ltar gu ru'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur bde chen gling pa/ pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa/ 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yu drung gling pa bcas lhan 'dzoms kyis gnas zhal gsar 'byed dang 'brel 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i gdan sa 'di thog mar phyag btab gnang nas bzung rje nyid kyi bka' slob dang mthun par dgon 'di'i bca' khrims ni/ de yang 'jig rten gyi khams su phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i rtsab ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che kho na la rag las shing / bstan pa de yang chos byed dge 'dun gyi mdzad spyod kho nar rag las pas na/ dge 'dun rnams kyi mdzad spyod rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun pa'i sdom pa gsum ldan ston pa'i rjes 'jug yin nges can zhig chags na sdom lngan gyi dge 'dun la sbyin bdag gi dad rdzas rnyed bkur gyi rigs dkon mchog mchod pa'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu thob/sdom med la zas gos sbyin pa rnams ngan slong la sbyin pa'i gras 39

kyi 'bras bu tsam las mi thob pa khyad par shin tu che/ byang snom dang / sngags sdom ni dbang po yang rab trī gyur pa'i spyod yul ni smos ma dgos skabs don gtso bo mchog dman kun gyi bsgrub bya'i snying pa sa sa thar pa'i snom payin na sdom pa gang la zhu ba'i yul mkhan po de yang 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdun nas thob na smos med dang / de min yang brtan mkhas kyi yon tan 'dul gzhung nas bshad pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid ldan pa zhig gi drung nas rab dge slong / 'bring dge tshul/ tha ma yang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nges par du zhu dgos shing grwa pa'i sgrigs khongs su ma zhugs gong nas 'don cha 'dzin klog 'pher nges zhu dag dang 'brel ba'i sku rim rnam gsum dang / smon lam rnam gsum/ ngag 'don rgyug 'bul zhus te bsgrigs zhugs thog 'chi gson gyi dkor la spyod pa las sngon 'gro shar khrid tsam dang / rtags skra bcad tsam dang/ sdod sa dgon nang yin pa 90

tsam gyis rang gar dkor la spyod mi chog rab byung gi rtags dang cha lugs ma byed par rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs mgo la ral lcog sogs cha lugs 'chol bar spyod shing rang la sdom pa med bzhin du gzhan la sdom pa sbyin pa'i mkhan po byed khul byed pa ni mdo rgyud dang dngos su 'gal ba'i bdud kyi spyod pa thos chung blun po'i rang rtags ngom pa yin pas de dag kyang rang si ma shes na mkhas pa tshad ldan rnams la/ bka' 'dri zhus te blang dor tshul bzhin bya rgyu/ dbyar dkar ldom/ ston nas snom grong 'brog khyim du 'gro rgyu sangs rgyas kyi gnang ba yin stabs bkag med zur du phud/ de min bla grwa gang yin yang sa sa' dgon shag trī gtan snod thog bza' btung gos brgyan dang bcas pa chos dang mthun pa'i sdig spang dge sgrub kyi spyod pa ngo lkog med pa rgyun 'khyongs dang 'brel ba'i gso ྅nga / ngabyar gnas/ dgag dbye/ nyer gnas/ snyung gnas/ sgrub mchod/9na

rgyun par sa sa' bla ma yi dam gyi bsnyen sgrub mtshams sdod sogs sa sa' lta grub dang mthun pa'i mdo rgyud khungs ldan gyi sgo nas skal ldan dwangs ba 'dren zhing 'byor ldan tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i zhing du nges par 'gro nges byed pa las mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang mi mthun zhing / khyad par shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa 'jam ma/gon bla ma'i thugs dgongs zab chos dang mi mthun pa'i rang bze'i chos dang spyod pa gsar sprod/ khyim gyi khur 'dzin/ dme gyod phug 'dugarmos rke rken nam/ phyugs nor rdzi bo/ dmag 'gro jag rgyugabud med dang ja ma sags dang mnyam 'dug chos kyi 'gro rte med par zhag gsum lhag grong khyim du sdod pa chos dang mi mthun pa'i chas dang spyod pa sogs ngos lkog sang du mi byed par chos pa'i ming don mtshungs par byed rgyu las rang snang gang shar gyi bya spyod mi bya/ bsam med ma rab re zung nas dgon 92

sder dma' 'byin bsgrigs gzhi la gtor bshigs byed mi byung tshe las sne do dam gyi rta lcags brgya re dang gnas dbyung btang dgos/ dge tshul slong rnams kyis sa sa' bslab bya dang mthun pa'i rtsab bzhi char gtogs dang bcas pa drag zhan sus thad nas byung tshe de 'phral ther 'don thog dgon la zhu bshags su gzan sham thabs/ rdor dril/ sgo dar/ lha mgon la snyan dar/ phyag 'bul nyin 'khyongs bska/nga ba/ 'go 'dzin bla mar zhu bshags su bzang ja 'khor re bcas 'phral sgrub kyi thog rang bsags sdig sbyang ched du rang lus rta lcag nyis brgya re sand sprod zhus te sa sa' pha khyim su rtsis sprod byed pa las dgon nang zhag gnyis lhag sdod mi chog de mtshungs bla ma las sne nas kyang bsgrigs khrims bkod 'doms thad dpe cha 'dzin klog gi mtshon/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi yon tan slob sbyong la rgyun brtan do 'khur che skyid kyi rang rang gi bde 'bras dang /93

dgon gyi lar rgya ma bor ba'i ngo kha che 'dod lhod yang min pas dam pos dam cing dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgyun 'khyongs zhu dgos pa gzhir bcas zhing / grwa dmangs yongs nasanyams len byed sgo la 'bud brdung 'chams gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig dang / rdul tshoni/ rung thal/ mchod pa gsham rgyu sogs lag len dgos nges rnams sbyang brtson byed rgyu dang / tshogos dkyil dang / yon rgyug gang gi skabs kyang ngag bcad byed pa las rang snang gang shar bshad gtam tshig gcig mi chog pas kha 'don gatshor bzungs zhu dgos bcas rang don rang gces kyi thar pa don gnyer la bsam nas bsgrigs khrims kyi 'khur gyi dge rtsabastan 'gror smin pas gong ma mchodayan gyi bstan srid gong nas gong 'phel yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu sogs 'jam ma/gon bla ma'i thugs dgongs dang mthun pa nges par zhu rgyu zhus pa las 'gal rigs dang / gong gsal don tshan dang 'gal 94

ba'i skya min ser min nya nyung mnyam gses sogs kyi spyod ngan gleng tsam mi 'byung ba'i bstan srung rdo rje'i be+er can dpang btsugs zhu rgyu dang / grwa gras nas gnas mjal dang / bla ma sogs rang mos gang yod sar dbang lung khrid gsum zhu bar 'gro 0yad na sngon tshud nas bla grwa sar dgongs zhu byas te 'gro bskyod byed pa las rang gar yul byol dang rang don chogs bgrod sogs mi chog 'dod na grwa pa dang ma 'dod phyir 'then byas tshe las sne nas nyes pa mig ltos la phan pa gcod dgos/las tshan yod med la ma ltos par grwa tshang mas bstan dgon nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba'i blo sems gcig bsgril gyi bstan 'gro'i mig rgyan du gyur pa zhig ji srid bar rgyun 'khyongs zhu dgos zhes gsungs so/ 'dir ma gsal ba bca' yig gzhan du bzhugs yod/brgyad pa deng sang dgon 'di'i gnas tshul skor rags 95

tsam bshad pa ni/ de ltar rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bstan pa bshad sgrub las gsum gyis bskyangs bas rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag mnyam med shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs kyi srog shing lta bur gyur na yang / skye rgu spyi sger gyi bsod nams dman pas bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir brgalu nas mi lo sum cu tsam gyi ring bod khams mtha' dbus kun gyi dgon sde phal mo che dang mtshungs par ngo r+shage bzhi pa zhes pa'i skabs su bshad sgrub kyi rnam pa thams cad ming gi lhag mar gyur cing /rten dang brten pa bcas thams cad gtor brlag tshab cher btang / tha na gtsug lag khang grwa shag bcas zhig thal sa phung rdo phung tsam las med par gyur/ rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i skabs mtha' bskor mchod rten sogs sngar cung zad lhag lus rnams kyang bzhigs pa sogs bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung rin thang bral ba'i rig dngos gna' rdzas bcas gtor 96

brlag gnod tshab ches cher theb tshul la bsam na ha cang yid skyo ba'i gangs ljongs rgud pa'i mtha' 'di la thug parastsar to/deng sang chos ldan bod 'bangs kyi dad pa'i rang dbang sprin gseb kyi nyi ma shar ma thag mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel dang / khong gi sku mched bla ma rin chen rnam rgyal dang / sngon gyi bla rgan rnams/ grwa kar dga' bcas lhan rgyas nas/ gdan sa 'di bskyar gso'i phrin las kyi dbu btsugs/ thog mar yang dag snangags khang chen mo bskyar bzhengs nang du lder bzo gu ru thog tshad nang bzhugs tshad ldan can/ gzhan sku 'dra dang thal thang gsar rnying nyung tsam/ sprul sku'i gzim chung / mtha' bskor mchod rten dang dung 'khor sogs brten dang brten pa bcas bskyar bzhengs/ dge 'dun sum cu lhag gis sngar srol dus mchod phal mo che dang 'chams dang bcas rmang gzhi tsam tshugs nas nyer mkho'i yo byad kyang mi )7

dman tsam zhig grub/ 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang sku phreng gsum pa mchog gis gtsug lag khang bskyar bzhengs kyi ched duganang sbyin rgya cher mdzad pa gzhir bzung rab chab sde baspangs rdzo+ogs nas dad mos kyi sgo nas las grwa bsgrigs cing 'du khang legs par grub/ deyi nang ljer bzo gu ru gtso 'khor gsum thog tshad gtsose sku gzugs dang zhal thang log bris bcas grub/ rje sku phreng gsum pa dang ba'i pa'i phyag mjod bstan 'dzin rdo rje mchog sis bstan 'gro'i don la thugs bskyed rgya chen po'i thog rnam kun legs pa'i bsa' slob dang 'brel sgrub khang bskyar bzhengs/ slob grwa gsar 'dzug 'du khang rgya bskyed btang rgyu sogs kyi ched du gzhi rtsadangos rdzas gya nom grangs mang gnang zin par ma zad da dung yang lo re bzhin bka' drin skyong bzhin mchis pas zhib rgyas su brngod par rngo ma thog/ slad mar khong gi thugs bskyed bka' drin brtse gzigs rgya mi chung ba gnang 98
