mus su mchis so/bstan pa bskyar bzhengs skabs sde dgon gnyis la bka' drin shin tu che ba'i mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel 'khrungs pa'i yul ni mdo khams sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i sa yi char gtogs rag chab zhes par/ yab grub thob gcod kyi brgyud pa pad+ma rig 'dzin dang / yum ṭ+wāṃ ki ma bo ya/na gnyis kyi sras su/ spyi lo 193zhoror ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams/ chung ngu'i dus byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das shing yi/ ge 'bri klog sogs tshegs med par mkhyen/ yab kyis rje mkhyen brtsechos kyi blo grose la phul mkhyen brtserin po ches kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa la gnang bas rje nyid nas snyigs dus 'dir rdzong shodardagon pa'i bstan pa la phan thog par gzigs pa 'dra/ khong gis bla ma dri med dang / khra skya dpal ldan sogs ris med dam pa'i skyes chen du ma'i mdun nas bka' rnying 99

gnyis gtso bore gyur pa'i chos lugs ris su ma chad pa'i dbang lung khrid sogs rgya cher gsan nas rdzong shod dgon rten dang brten pa bcas bskyar bzhengs kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin nas dgung grangs don gsum pa spyi la 200nalar yab tshang du dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gshegs tshul bstan to/ rdzong shod mchoge sprul tshul khrims kyi yang srid 'khrul pa med pa mchog spru/la bstan 'dzin nyi ma mchog ni/ yab pan phrug dang / yum bsod marlo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i me sbrul lor/ mtshan dpe'i me tog gsar du bzhad/ chung nas dam pa'i 'bras rtags mngon du sad nas rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang ba la gsan bsam sngon du 'gro ba la rag las par dgongs nas dpal yul snga 'gyur mtho sleb mdo sngags thos bsam dar rgyas gling 'dir grwa sar bzhugs nas gsan sbyong dpyis phyin pa gnang / skyabs mgon na00

si tu rin po che mchog nas mchog sprul tshul khrims kyi yang srid 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin dang 'brel gsung shog bstsal bas dad ldan 'bangs mi kun dga' spro tshad med kyis yid ches kyi gnas su gyur/ bshad grwa 'dir de sngon lo bcu phrag si gsang chen snga 'gyur ba'i bka' srol nyan thos kyi theg pa nas yang gsang snying thig gi bar gyi rim dgu'i theg pa'i chos tshul thun mong rig gnas dang bcas pa rgya gar me sor rnam gling bshad grwa mdo sngags ril pa'i 'byung gnas gling si bsgrigs srol dang mthun pa'i rtsaba'i slo ba tshan dang / yan lag gi slob tshan cha tshang lo dgu'i ring lung rigs man ngag tshad mas gsan bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad pas mkhas pa'i go sar dbang bsgyur te bshad grwa 'di'i thog mar skyor dpon gyi mtshan phul/ 'dzin grwa mthar phyin nas slob dpon gyi go gnas dang mtshan bzhes thog bshad grwa 'dir da skabs dge rgan gyi phyas na0na

las gnang bzhin du bzhugs yod/ ma tshad lo dgu'i ring zur du ris med bstan 'dzin skyes chen mchog sprul rin po che thub bzang dang / mkhan rgan kun bzang sogs dam pa du ma'i mdun nas/ gter chen rat+na gling pa'i gsung 'bum/ gnam chos chos skor cha tshang / mkhan po ngag dga'i bka' 'bum/ma/khyen kong rnam gnyis kyi bka' 'bum/ rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bka' 'bum/ chags med bka' 'bum/ snying thig ya bzhi bcas kyi smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab brten bklag lung bcas gang mchis kun rdzogs par gsan pas dam pa'i chos kyi thugs rgyud yongs su gang bar gyur/gzhan yang gnam chos rtsarlung dang / 'pho khrid bcas sbyang brtson gnad 'khyol mdzad cing deng sang dus dbang gi sprul sku phal che dang mi mtshungs nga/ra khong gi mi gzhi dang mdzad spyod sogs bshad grwa 'dir bzhugs rgyus yod mtho dman kun gyis na02

bsngags brjod dang yid ches yi rangs yid smon byed pa'i gnas su gyur pas slad mar khong nas rgyal bstan sgyi dang /khyad par du dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la phan thog rgya cher 'byung ba'i rmang gzhi'i rten 'brel mngon du gyurayad pa ni don gnas kyi ngo ༷de lags pas rjes 'jug kun dga' bar rigs shing / deng sang gi sprul sku phal mo che nang bzhin / grub thob kyi mdzad spo+od dang / sgor mo/'i ched du sku tshe mi gron par don brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che la don gnas kyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang rgyu'i re bskul dang smon 'dun bcas ni zhar byung 'phros don lags so/ gzhanapagang khong gis sku mched u rgyan tshe ring sogs kyis kyang rdzong shod dgon du rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i bka' brgyud mar mi dwag gsum sku che legs bzhengs pa sogs thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gnang bzhin mchis/ rang dgon bla ma kun bzang ye shes na03

sogs bla grwa rnams kyang thugs mthun khrims gtsang kyis sgrub khang bskyar bzhengs sogs sngar srol bshad sgrub las gsum dar spel gtong rgyu'i las la 'bad brtson byed bzhin pa ma tshad/gzhi byes bla ser mchod sde dang bcas pa mthun bsgril dang sems shugs rgya cher thog rgyal dbang yab sras kyi ring lugs phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad+ma lta bu'i don brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che kun mthun kun 'phags 'di nyid 'dzam gling yangs pa'i tha gru kun tu khyab brdal du spel thub pa'i re smon re sgug byas nas yod pas de de bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang / bsgrub brgyud bsta na pa 'di la lhag bsam mi dman pa'i bla sprul dang mkhan po mnga' thang 'byor pa che ba'i sbyin bdag bcas nas mdzad par zhu ba ni zhar 'phros dgos dbang gi gtam du smras so/ /na04
